fields.title: Premium Staff Dashboard & Live AI Usage Tracking
fields.description:
We've launched a comprehensive Staff Dashboard for superusers, featuring:
- Live AI Usage Tracking: Real-time dollar and token monitoring for DeepSeek and Gemini.
- Service Connectivity Status: Instant visibility into which AI models are powering your Story Support and Book Imports.
- Site-Wide Analytics: High-level stats for users, books, and recent platform activity.
- DeepSeek Integration: Direct balance monitoring and top-up links.

fields.title: DeepSeek Engine Integration
fields.description:
Switched core AI functionalities to DeepSeek for superior narrative reasoning:
- Ghostwriter: Enhanced with DeepSeek-Chat for natural prose continuation.
- Book Importer: Now utilizes DeepSeek-Reasoner for complex story extraction.
- Gemini Fallback: Implemented automatic failover to Gemini 1.5 Pro/Flash to ensure 100% uptime.

fields.title: Universal Search & Performance Boost
fields.description:
Searching your story is now faster and more comprehensive:
- Unified Search: Search across Books, Chapters, Characters, Events, and WorldWiki from a single bar.
- Sidebar Integration: The search bar is now pinned to your sidebar for instant access from any page.
- Query Optimization: Database queries have been tuned for large-scale series (distinct results and faster indexing).

fields.title: Relationship Mapping & Visualizations
fields.description:
Visualize the complex web of your narrative:
- Dynamic Relationship Map: A force-directed graph showing character connections.
- Strength & Trust Levels: Precisely define how characters feel about each other (1-10 scale).
- Evolution Tracking: Record how bonds change across different books in your series.

fields.title: Writing Mode — Full In-Editor Experience
fields.description:
A dedicated, distraction-free writing environment is now available for every chapter:
- Zen Mode: Hide all sidebars and focus entirely on your manuscript.
- Floating Formatting Toolbar: A bubble menu appears on text selection with H1/H2/H3, bold, italic, bullet list, and blockquote controls.
- Chapter Cast Panel: See which characters appear in the current chapter as you write.
- In-Editor Word Count: Live word count updates as you type.
- Auto-Save: Your draft is saved automatically as you work.

fields.title: AI Book Importer — Intelligent Story Extraction
fields.description:
Upload an existing manuscript and let the platform do the heavy lifting:
- Automatic Chapter Detection: The importer splits your novel into chapters and populates them instantly.
- Character Extraction: Characters are identified and linked to the chapters they first appear in.
- Book & Description Generation: A book title, summary, and metadata are generated from your content.
- Progress Tracking: A live progress bar shows the import status in real time.
- Bulk Chapter Upload: Alternatively, upload multiple chapter files at once via drag-and-drop.

fields.title: World Wiki — Lore & World-Building Hub
fields.description:
Build and manage the lore of your fictional world in a structured wiki:
- Categorised Entries: Organise locations, organisations, artefacts, concepts, and more.
- Rich Descriptions: Add detailed descriptions and notes to each world entry.
- Book Linking: Attach world entries to specific books in your series.
- World List View: Browse all lore entries from a clean, filterable list.

fields.title: Dashboard Overhaul — Writer's Command Centre
fields.description:
The dashboard has been completely redesigned as a central hub for your creative work:
- Writing Stats: Daily word counts, streaks, and session totals displayed at a glance.
- Recent Activity Feed: See your latest books, chapters, and character edits in one place.
- Focus Mode: Set a writing goal for the session and track it on the dashboard.
- Quick Navigation: Jump directly to your active book, latest chapter, or the relationship map.
- Daily Quote: An inspiring writing quote appears each day to motivate your session.

fields.title: Character Deep Dive — AI-Powered Character Analysis
fields.description:
Get a thorough, in-depth profile for any character from your story bible:
- Psychological Profile: Personality traits, speech patterns, and behavioural analysis generated from your notes.
- Narrative Role Analysis: Understand how a character functions within your story's structure.
- Motivation & Arc Summary: Key motivations and character arc highlighted automatically.
- Chapter Appearances: All chapters the character appears in are listed and linked.
- Sync to Profile: Save the generated insights directly back to the character's profile.

fields.title: Story Bible Export — Professional PDF Output
fields.description:
Export a complete, formatted story bible for any book in your series:
- Full Book Summary: Title, description, status, and word count targets included.
- Character Roster: Every character with their description, role, and motivation.
- Timeline of Events: All plot events listed in chronological order.
- Relationship Overview: A textual summary of character connections.
- World-Building Notes: Lore entries from the World Wiki included in the export.

fields.title: Timeline View — Chronological Story Planner
fields.description:
Plan and visualise every plot event across your series on a structured timeline:
- Vertical & Horizontal Views: Switch between a vertical list and a horizontal scroll-based timeline.
- Drag-to-Reorder: Rearrange events directly on the timeline without editing forms.
- Scene-Level Detail: Each event supports a title, description, location, associated characters, and tags.
- Book Filtering: Filter the timeline to show only events from a specific book.
- Word Count per Event: Track estimated word counts at the scene level.

fields.title: Scene Outline & Chapter Summary — Instant Structure Generator
fields.description:
Two new AI-assisted tools to help you plan and review your chapters:
- Scene Outline: Generate a structured breakdown of scenes for any chapter based on your notes and plot events.
- Chapter Summary: Produce a concise narrative summary of any chapter's content.
- Both tools are accessed directly inside the Chapter Detail view with a single click.
- Summaries can be saved back to the chapter for future reference.

fields.title: Character Codex — Profiles, Motivation & Relationships
fields.description:
The character management system has been significantly expanded:
- Motivation Field: Capture what drives each character at their core.
- Avatar Upload: Add a portrait image to any character profile.
- Role Classification: Tag characters as Protagonist, Antagonist, Supporting, or Minor.
- Book & Chapter Tracking: Log which book and chapter a character first appears in.
- Linked Relationships: View all relationships for a character directly from their profile page.

fields.title: Social Login — Sign In with Google
fields.description:
Authentication has been made faster and more accessible:
- Sign in with Google: One-click sign-in using your existing Google account.
- Auto Profile Creation: A full user profile is created automatically on first social login.
- Secure Token Handling: Full OAuth 2.0 implementation with secure state management.
- Fallback to Email: Traditional email and password login remains available for all users.

fields.title: Relationship Suggestion Engine
fields.description:
The Relationship Map now includes intelligent suggestions to enrich your character web:
- Auto-Suggest: Based on your existing character profiles and story events, the engine proposes likely relationships.
- One-Click Accept: Approve a suggestion and it is added to the map instantly.
- Custom Relationship Types: Define unique bond types (mentor, rival, estranged family, etc.) beyond the presets.
- Strength & Trust Sliders: Fine-tune the intensity of each relationship on a granular scale.

fields.title: Tag System & Content Filtering
fields.description:
A flexible tagging system has been added across books, chapters, and events:
- Custom Tags: Create any tag you need — themes, locations, POV characters, tone, and more.
- Multi-Object Support: Apply tags to books, chapters, and timeline events independently.
- Filter by Tag: Narrow down your timeline or chapter list by selecting specific tags.
- Tag Manager: Create, rename, and delete tags from a dedicated management view.
- Colour-Coded Labels: Tags display as colour-coded chips throughout the interface.

fields.title: Tag Display & Filtering Fixes
fields.description:
- Tags not rendering on the Timeline Events list after being applied.
- Filtering by tag on the Chapter list returning zero results despite matches existing.
- Tag chip colour not persisting after a page refresh.

fields.title: Timeline Ordering & Navigation Fixes
fields.description:
- Drag-and-drop event reorder not persisting after a hard page refresh.
- Horizontal timeline scroll position resetting to the start on browser back navigation.
- Event detail panel failing to open when two events shared the same title.

fields.title: Authentication & Session Fixes
fields.description:
- Social login redirect sending returning users to the registration page instead of the dashboard.
- Session timeout not being extended correctly on page interaction.
- Password reset email not dispatching on accounts created via social login.

fields.title: Relationship Map Rendering Fixes
fields.description:
- Edge labels overlapping character nodes when zoomed out to full-series view.
- Selected character highlight not clearing when clicking an empty area of the canvas.
- Map not loading when a character had no defined relationships.

fields.title: Relationship Suggestions Fixes
fields.description:
- Suggestions engine proposing relationships for character pairs that were already connected.
- Accepting a suggestion occasionally creating a duplicate relationship entry in the database.
- Strength slider defaulting to 0 instead of 5 when accepting a suggestion.

fields.title: Search & Indexing Fixes
fields.description:
- Search bar retaining the previous query text after navigating away and returning.
- Character results appearing multiple times when a character appeared in more than one book.
- World Wiki entries not appearing in universal search results.

fields.title: Book Import Stability Fixes
fields.description:
- Import stalling at 90% progress on manuscripts containing special characters (em-dashes, ellipses) in chapter headings.
- Progress bar not resetting to zero when re-importing an existing book.
- Character names containing apostrophes being truncated during extraction.

fields.title: Dashboard Stats & Display Fixes
fields.description:
- Dashboard session word count not zeroing out at midnight when a writing session spanned two days.
- Aggregate word count not updating on the dashboard after a chapter was deleted.
- Recent activity feed showing duplicate entries when the same chapter was edited in quick succession.

fields.title: Scene Outline & Chapter Summary Fixes
fields.description:
- Scene outline generator pulling characters from the wrong book when a series had chapters with identical titles.
- Chapter summary occasionally returning an empty response on the first request; now retries automatically.
- Save-to-chapter button not activating after a summary was generated.

fields.title: Writing Mode Editor Fixes
fields.description:
- Auto-save incorrectly marking the document as having unsaved changes immediately on load.
- Cursor jumping to the beginning of the document when auto-save fired mid-sentence.
- Bubble formatting toolbar not dismissing when clicking outside it on touch devices.

fields.title: Dashboard & Usage Tracking Fixes
fields.description:
- Usage counters not resetting between separate user sessions in the Staff Dashboard.
- Service connectivity status incorrectly showing offline when the response was slow rather than absent.
- Site-wide user count stat caching stale data for up to 10 minutes after a new registration.
